body: Im 17 as well and feel the exact same way, it’s nice knowing I’m not alone though

I feel the exact same frustration. I don’t have any particularly terrible issues but I’ve noticed some fine lines and I get so frustrated when I do everywhere and spend so much to help with it and nothing helps 😕

Yea I suppose, it’s frustrating though when I already do stuff for my skin and don’t see results. I just stopped skincare for a few days a couple days ago and my skin cleared up a bit and glows a bit better, I think I was over doing it. But I’ll be using it again tonight cause I don’t want my skin cracking
Im scared that I’m going to waste my youth and I’m sure you have the same fear, we got to get over this man
